attack_surface.boundary: the local machine: what is written to and read from disk, and what is accepted from the index and refs

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: a fresh clone has nothing to compare with
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: writable and read-only clones refuse a host that moves a branch backwards (--accept-rewind to override)

proposed.fix: read_ref validates commit_id against the object-id shape (obj-cas-imm-<12|32 hex>) and raises otherwise; is_store_path anchors with \Z and refuses '.'/'..' leaves
proposed.test: Known_Gaps or Fixed: a ref whose commit_id is '../../x' is refused at read, not at open

risk_decision.rationale: awaiting the step-4 verification or a fix

vulnerabilities.title: read_ref returns the decrypted 'commit_id' unvalidated (None, non-str, any string); it flows into Vault__Object_Store.load as a path component
